answer: Retiring an identity early forfeits 25% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the river forfeiture shows up in the pearl totals with the haven audit listing each retired key. An operator that abandons 72 aliases after a single epoch therefore destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt.
